title: tool_search exposes a large repeated tool catalog after targeted loads
wanted_capability: After a targeted tool_search load, the agent-facing response should stay compact: loaded tool names and schemas for the requested tools, plus a small summary of remaining available tools. The full additional-tool catalog should be hidden behind an explicit request or one-time disclosure, not repeatedly injected into subsequent context where it obscures the actual work.
missing_primitive: compact targeted tool_search response without repeated full catalog sidecar
fallback_used: Ignored the repeated available-tool catalog and focused on the loaded tool schemas.
notes: In this harness shakedown, a targeted select load correctly loaded the requested tools, but the surrounding developer-side catalog remained very large and repeated. This makes a policy-conformant tool load look noisy and consumes attention/context with unrelated surfaces.
